hero.title: Post like you normally do. Earn from the attention you already have.
hero.sub: Brands pay to appear naturally in your photos and Stories. You pick the brand, you pick where, you approve everything. Then you post as usual and get paid per view.
hero.phoneCaption: An ordinary photo. A small nod. 42 kr.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Browse brands paying right now. Only take the ones you like.
how.step2Body: Upload the photo you were going to post anyway. Choose where the product appears. Approve the result.
how.step3Body: Post to your own account with clear ad disclosure. We verify the views and pay via Swish.

estimator.title: What could you earn?
estimator.avgViews: Average views per Story or Reel
estimator.note: Actual payout is set per campaign.

trust.title: What we promise
trust.card1Body: Nothing is posted without you seeing it. Regenerate, move, or reject — free.
trust.card2Body: Every post carries clear disclosure. That's the law, and it's how we keep it real.
trust.card3Body: One person, one account. Brands know every participant is real. No bots, no fakes.

who.title: Who is it for?
who.line: You don't need to be an influencer. 300 followers is enough.

faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: No. From around 300 followers or 100 average views.
faq.a2: You upload it, choose where the brand goes, and see the result before anything is published. You post it yourself. NOD never posts for you.
faq.a3: Swish, within 48 hours of verification. Minimum payout 100 kr.
faq.a4: Yes. Every post is clearly marked as advertising, as required by Swedish marketing law. Undisclosed posts aren't paid.
faq.a5: To make sure every participant is a real person over 18, and so you can be paid via Swish.
faq.a6: Yes, as long as they're yours. Each qualifies on its own.

hero.title: Reach thousands of real social circles through one campaign.
hero.sub: NOD places your product naturally in the everyday posts of real, BankID-verified people in your target market. Disclosed, contextual, verified per view. One dashboard. One effective CPM.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.body: From 60 kr per 1,000 qualified views, plus optional fixed per placement. You set the numbers above our floors. Prepaid; unspent budget refunded.

terms.quizQuestion: Which of these is correct ad disclosure?
terms.quizOptionA: Ad – in partnership with {brand}, first in the caption
terms.quizOptionB: #ad at the bottom among 20 other hashtags
terms.quizOptionC: No disclosure, you can tell it's a product anyway
terms.quizWrong: Not quite. Disclosure goes first and has to be clear.
terms.quizRight: Exactly. First in the caption, clear, in the audience's language.
